entries.source_quote: Umbral Dash passive: Aatrox heals for 16% (+1.1% per 100 bonus health) of non-persistent post-mitigation damage he deals to enemy champions - an always-on lifesteal layer across the entire duel.
Deathbringer Stance: periodically empowers the next attack to deal bonus max-HP damage; in a prolonged duel the proc fires repeatedly, ramping sustained damage output each cycle.
Deathbringer Stance heals Aatrox for 100% of the post-mitigation bonus damage dealt on each empowered proc, continuously refilling HP throughout a prolonged exchange.
World Ender: grants bonus attack damage and amplifies all self-healing for 10 seconds, dramatically amplifying both the RAMP and DUELHEAL mechanisms while active.
World Ender: amplifies Aatrox's healing from all sources by a significant percentage for its duration, turning already strong lifesteal into fight-winning attrition.
Assassin's Mark: casting an ability creates a ring; stepping out empowers next AA, cycling the ring continuously through the duel
Perfect Execution: two-stage dash - second cast fires within a 3s window of the first, re-engaging mid-duel
Dirty Fighting: after landing two consecutive basic attacks Akshan gains a shield, providing a recurring defensive layer while he fights
Triumphant Roar: heals Alistar and nearby allies after he stuns or knocks up an enemy (3s CD); fires repeatedly whenever his Q/W CC connects in a prolonged duel
Unbreakable Will: strips all CC and reduces incoming damage by 55-75% for 7s; a massive defensive window that lets Alistar absorb a full duel exchange at reduced damage
Public Execution passive: Ambessa heals for a percentage of post-mitigation damage dealt by her active abilities, providing continuous in-combat lifesteal across her sustained Q-W-E combo loop
Tantrum: passively reduces incoming physical damage by a flat amount, providing a continuous damage-reduction layer throughout any sustained melee exchange

Despair: Amumu deals magic damage per second equal to a percentage of nearby enemies' max HP while toggled on; the longer he stays close in a 1v1 the more total damage this racks up, punishing high-health targets
Rebirth: on taking lethal damage Anivia revives as an egg with hard CC immunity, granting a full second health bar mid-duel before she can be killed a second time
Spirit Abjuration: every 3 hits on enemies grants a free pounce, enabling repeated re-engagement in a sustained fight
Spirit Abjuration: for each active Spirit, Aurora is healed for 3-20 (based on level) (+ 2% AP) every second, up to 4x at 4 Spirits

Royal Maelstrom: while channeling, Belveth gains 20% (+ 100% life steal) life steal and rapidly slashes the lowest-HP enemy, converting rapid on-hit strikes into HP recovery during a defensive channel window

Royal Maelstrom: Belveth enters a defensive stance gaining damage reduction for 1.5 seconds while continuously slashing, allowing her to tank incoming damage while still dealing damage - a brief but real keep-swinging endurance layer

Endless Banquet passive: every other basic attack on-hit against the same marked target deals escalating bonus true damage that stacks infinitely (capped at 5 vs epic monsters), so the longer the duel runs the higher her per-attack true damage climbs
Above and Below: hitting an enemy champion resets the Void Surge dash cooldown of the struck direction, re-enabling her cardinal-dash attack cycle within a sustained 1v1

Unbreakable raises Braum's shield for up to 4 seconds, blocking projectiles entirely from the front and reducing incoming damage by 30-40%; re-usable on a ~14-18s cooldown, providing a recurring frontal damage-reduction window in a sustained 1v1.
Hemorrhage stacks deal increasing bleed damage per stack, building continuously as Briar attacks in melee range.
Crimson Curse grants Briar lifesteal that scales with her missing HP - the lower she falls the more she heals per hit, providing continuous in-fight recovery throughout the duel.
Briar's ult launches her into an uncontrollable berserk state removing all self-directed fear, sustaining full offensive output until the duel ends.
Maul's frenzy state causes Briar to heal for a percentage of damage dealt with every attack, refilling HP throughout the duel.
Briar's frenzy grants increasing Attack Speed the longer she remains in combat, ramping her DPS over the extended fight.
Hookshot: Camille fires a hookshot to a wall, then can launch to a target location - enabling re-engagement and sustained pressure cycles within a duel.
Adaptive Defenses: Camille's next basic attack against a champion grants her a shield based on her maximum health (AD scaling: 20-50% max HP).
Camille is healed for 100% of this additional damage post-mitigation against enemy champions in the outer half of Tactical Sweep.
Twin Fang: cooldown reduces to ~0.75s when target is poisoned, enabling near-continuous re-fire throughout a prolonged duel

Hemorrhage: each ability and auto applies a stack (max 5); at 5 stacks Darius gains Noxian Might granting 30-230 bonus attack damage and instantly applies 5 stacks, making every subsequent hit dramatically harder the longer the duel runs
Decimate: heals Darius for 17-51% of his missing health per enemy champion hit by the blade portion (outer arc), providing a significant mid-duel HP refill when he connects the outer edge

Noxian Guillotine: resets its cooldown on a champion kill and at rank 3 has no cooldown after the 20-second recast window - allowing Darius to re-execute within the same duel if a stacked target dies and a second target enters range
Lunar Rush: grants a free CD reset after casting if Moonlight is on the target; allows Diana to re-dash onto the target repeatedly within the duel when Q-Moonlight is maintained
Moonsilver Blade: every third attack triggers a cleaving empowered strike; provides a periodic auto-enhancement that rewards sustained melee combat exchanges
Pale Cascade: summons 3 orbiting spheres that shield Diana; if all 3 detonate the shield refreshes, providing a renewable defensive layer that can cycle multiple times in a prolonged duel

Spinning Axe empowers Draven's current attack to deal bonus physical damage; catching the rebound immediately re-readies the mark, so Draven can maintain two axes continuously, sustaining elevated per-auto damage output for the full length of a duel.

Blood Rush resets its own cooldown whenever Draven catches a Spinning Axe, granting stacking attack speed and movement speed refreshes throughout a prolonged exchange; conditional on successfully catching axes.
Resourceless kit with no mana or energy cost on any ability; can sustain offensive output indefinitely through a long exchange
Adrenaline Rush: regenerates 0.8% maximum health each second, continuously refilling HP through any prolonged fight
Maximum Dosage: instantly restores 20% missing health then regenerates up to 20% max health over 10 seconds, reversing attrition mid-duel
Heart Zapper: stores a portion of damage taken as gray health; re-casting returns that stored gray health as a direct heal, providing a recurring mid-duel HP recovery on a short cooldown
Z-Drive Resonance applies a mark on third hit to the same target, dealing bonus damage and briefly slowing, re-cycling burst every few attacks.
Chronobreak rewinds Ekko to his position 4 seconds prior at full health recorded then, fully restoring HP mid-duel and dealing burst damage on arrival.
Chronobreak rewinds Ekko, effectively resetting his ability state and repositioning him to re-open his combo within the same duel.
Parallel Convergence's aftershock grants Ekko a large shield when he enters the zone, providing a defensive layer mid-duel on a moderate cooldown.
Spider Queen - Spider Form: Elise's basic attacks heal her for 6/8/10/12 (+8% AP) on-hit while in Spider Form - a continuous lifesteal layer that sustains her through a prolonged melee exchange.
Skittering Frenzy (Spider Form): Elise and her Spiderlings gain bonus attack speed for 3 seconds and her attack timer is reset - a short AS steroid that spikes her DPS window in an extended melee.
While below 250-590 (based on level) (+ 250% AP) health, Evelynn heals herself for 15-150 (based on level) every second.
Last Caress deals doubled damage below 30% HP and resets Evelynn to camouflage; the execute threshold plus reset cycle is a discrete conditional power burst central to her duel pattern.
Rising Spell Force: hitting abilities stacks up to 5 charges of 8% bonus attack speed each, accumulating through the fight
Mystic Shot: each hit reduces all of Ezreal's cooldowns by 1.5s, continuously refreshing W, E, and R across a prolonged exchange
Bountiful Harvest: Fiddlesticks heals itself for 25/32.5/40/47.5/55% of pre-mitigation damage dealt to champions over the 2s drain channel
Duelist's Dance: striking a Vital heals Fiora for 40-115 (based on level) (+0.55 bonus AD) HP
Duelist's Dance: after striking a Vital a new one appears on a different side; each Vital proc re-energizes her combo cadence within a single duel
Lunge: cooldown is halved when the strike hits a Vital, reducing effective CD to ~3s in active duel; effectively re-fires the gap-close every Vital proc
Grand Challenge: if Fiora hits all 4 Vitals or the target dies, a healing zone appears granting her and nearby allies 20-45% of max HP over 2s
Riposte: Fiora parries all incoming damage and disabling effects for 0.75s then slows or stuns the target; window must be timed correctly
Trial by Fire: empowered melee strike every few seconds deals bonus true damage and sets the target on fire; re-fires on a short cooldown through the duel
Remove Scurvy: consumes an orange to cure all crowd control and restore a chunk of health, providing a mid-duel heal reset

Judgment spins continuously for up to 3 seconds dealing repeated physical hits; Garen can reactivate the spin cycle to maintain output, providing continuous damage pressure that rewards staying in close range over the length of a duel.

Decisive Strike refreshes on a short cooldown, empowering Garen's next basic attack with a silence and auto-reset; repeatedly re-applicable within a prolonged duel, each cycle adding a guaranteed silencing strike and re-firing the empowered auto.

Courage passively builds bonus armor and magic resistance by farming minions and champions (up to +30 bonus armor, stacking toward a cap); once accrued, these permanent resistance stacks provide an always-on durability layer that makes every duel Garen survives slightly more winnable.
Rage Gene passively builds Rage while Gnar attacks and takes damage; at 100 Rage he transforms into Mega Gnar, massively amplifying his dueling power.
Mega Gnar form grants substantially increased base stats (HP, Armor, MR, AD) and a slowing enhanced auto, outlasting opponents during the transformation window.

Happy Hour: periodically, after casting an ability, Gragas heals himself for 5.5% of his maximum health - a meaningful attrition heal that accumulates significantly across a prolonged exchange with repeated ability casts.
Drunken Rage: Gragas channels to gain damage reduction for 2.5 seconds, providing a defensive window that extends his staying power in a sustained 1v1.
Quickdraw: Graves dashes and reloads one shell, allowing him to sustain combat pressure and maintain his True Grit armor stacks throughout a prolonged exchange.
True Grit: Graves gains stacking bonus armor (up to 8 stacks) for each shell loaded while in sustained combat, meaning his defensive profile grows the longer the duel continues.
Skip 'n Slash: empowers Gwen's next several attacks with bonus attack speed and magic damage on cast
A Thousand Cuts: on-hit bonus magic damage equal to a percent of max HP, healing Gwen whenever it damages a champion
Hallowed Mist: creates a zone that enemies outside cannot target Gwen through, granting a defensive endurance window in the duel
Rampage: each consecutive Rampage hit reduces the next cast's cooldown and cost, building continuous attack cadence that accelerates the longer the fight runs
Spirit of Dread: Hecarim is healed for 25% of the post-mitigation damage dealt to enemies within the area from all sources over the 4s window
Test of Spirit: extracts an enemy's spirit as a Vessel; Tentacle hits on the Vessel heal Illaoi repeatedly over the 10s vessel window, turning a 1v1 into a sustained attrition win
Prophet of an Elder God: Illaoi periodically spawns a Tentacle on nearby walls; more Tentacles active = more simultaneous hits as the duel extends
Leap of Faith: immediately spawns a Tentacle for each nearby enemy champion, massively refreshing the tentacle army mid-duel for an instant power spike
Harsh Lesson: Illaoi leaps to strike, commanding a nearby Tentacle to slam; each Tentacle hit heals her, sustaining through the duel on a 4s CD
Ionian Fervor: each nearby enemy champion stacks bonus attack speed and grants physical damage reduction at max stacks, ramping power the longer the duel continues
Ionian Fervor at max stacks: grants 10% physical and magic damage reduction, providing sustained DR throughout an extended exchange
Bladesurge: fully resets on killing or assisting a target; within a duel with minions or low-HP targets nearby it re-fires continuously, maintaining high effective DPS
Defiant Dance: channels to reduce incoming physical damage by up to 90% during the wind-up, then releases for damage; provides a meaningful burst DR window inside a prolonged 1v1
Counter Strike: Jax dodges all basic attacks for up to 2 seconds, then stuns nearby enemies - hard block of the opponent's offensive output within the duel.
Relentless Assault: Jax's attack speed increases by 3.5-11.5% per stack, stacking up to 8 times as he strikes, compounding throughout the duel.
Grandmaster-at-Arms passive stacks grant bonus armor and magic resistance with each hit; active unleashes AoE magic damage and keeps resistances elevated through the fight.
Grandmaster-at-Arms passive grants up to 100/140/180 bonus armor and MR accumulated during the fight, sustaining Jax's defensive profile across a long exchange.
Second Skin: autos and abilities build Plasma stacks on enemies; at 4 stacks detonates for bonus magic damage scaling with target max HP, rewarding extended auto-trading
Rend: damage dealt scales directly with the number of Spears embedded in the target; each basic attack embeds another Spear, so DPS compounds the longer the duel runs
Void Stone: Kassadin permanently takes 10% reduced magic damage - a sustained minor defensive layer that contributes to his attrition durability against magic-damage duelists.
Riftwalk: stacks mana cost and damage each successive cast within a short window; in a prolonged 1v1 the repeated resets compound into escalating burst per cast.
Riftwalk: very short cooldown (1.5s at max rank) allows repeated re-fires within a single duel, effectively re-cycling the combo at a rate no other ability matches.
Voracity: whenever an enemy champion dies within 3 seconds of Katarina damaging them, all basic ability cooldowns are reset, enabling a full second rotation within the duel window.
Voracity: Katarina also recovers 15% of her missing health on enemy champion takedown, providing meaningful HP restoration that extends her staying power mid-duel.
Bouncing Blade leaves a dagger; picking up daggers reduces all ability cooldowns by 78% - enabling rapid re-fire of the full ability sequence within one duel.
Whirling Death: channels spinning blades for 2.5 seconds; cooldown is reduced by 15 seconds on each nearby enemy takedown, enabling re-use within the same duel window.
Divine Ascent: stacks attack speed with every ability and AA; at stack thresholds unlocks ranged, then AoE, then flaming ranged AoE attacks
Divine Judgment: renders Kayle (and an ally) invulnerable for 2.5s, providing a full damage-immunity endurance window
Celestial Blessing: heals Kayle (and an ally) and grants bonus movement speed on cast
The Darkin Scythe: Kayn heals for 25% of post-mitigation damage dealt by his abilities (Rhaast form further amplifies this sustain)
Umbral Trespass (Darkin Bonus): Rhaast heals for 11.25% (+ 7.5% per 100 bonus AD) of the target's maximum health after the recast - massive mid-duel refill gated on Rhaast form
Lightning Rush: Kennen transforms into a ball of electricity gaining 100% bonus attack speed and energizing his next 5 attacks to each apply a mark of the storm
Mark of the Storm: at 3 marks the target is stunned for 1-1.5s; Kennen can reapply marks through repeated abilities re-firing his stun within a prolonged duel
Void Spike: heals Kha'Zix if he is within the explosion radius when the spike detonates on an enemy - a minor self-heal available every 9s when he positions himself inside melee range for the burst
Mark of the Kindred: each stack permanently increases Kindred's damage, making her stronger the more marks she has accumulated heading into any 1v1
Lamb's Respite: creates a zone where no unit can be reduced below 1 HP, giving Kindred a guaranteed survival window mid-duel to heal up and continue fighting when the zone expires
Wolf's Frenzy: Wolf independently attacks enemies within the zone, adding consistent bonus damage that continues throughout the duel independent of Lamb's actions
Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard: dismount grants Kled a second effective health bar; remounting restores Skaarl's health, giving effective double HP in a prolonged 1v1
Courage bar fills as Kled fights; reaching 100 Courage triggers a remount that grants full Skaarl HP, rewarding sustained aggression in the duel

Bio-Arcane Barrage is active for 8 seconds, causing Kog'Maw's basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage equal to a percentage of the target's maximum health on-hit; each auto within the window strips proportional health, turning his attack speed into a sustained health-shred ramp conditional on W being active.

Dauntless Instinct: K'Sante's abilities mark enemies and his next basic attack consumes the mark to deal bonus max-HP physical damage (12 + 1-2% per level of target's max health) - a sustained on-hit ramp tied to his 3.5s Q cooldown throughout the duel

All Out: K'Sante sheds defensive stats but gains 50% bonus armor penetration, a 65% max-HP health threshold, 20% omnivamp, and enhanced ability modifiers - enabling him to outlast a single isolated opponent over a prolonged 1v1 lockdown
All Out: K'Sante gains 20% omnivamp during the All Out form, converting his sustained enhanced-damage output back into HP recovery throughout the extended duel window
Flurry: after casting an ability, Lee Sin's next 2 basic attacks gain bonus attack speed and restore energy, enabling rapid ability re-cycling within a sustained exchange.
Iron Will: grants lifesteal and spell vamp for 4 seconds, providing meaningful mid-fight healing when activated during an exchange.
Iron Will also grants armor and magic resist for its duration, providing a short defensive layer that extends Lee Sin's staying power in a 1v1.
Dream-Laden Bough: heals Lillia for 6-90 (based on level) (+ 30% AP) on hit against champions, providing continuous self-healing during the duel
Frozen Tomb self-cast: Lissandra enters stasis for 2.5s and heals herself up to 200 + 110% AP total (scaling with missing health), giving a mid-duel survival window on a long cooldown
Sap Magic passively heals Maokai after nearby spells are cast, restoring a percentage of max HP periodically throughout a prolonged duel.
Twisted Advance roots the target and heals Maokai for a flat amount on arrival, providing in-combat HP restoration during the exchange.
Wuju Style: active grants bonus true damage on basic attacks for 5 seconds, a strong sustained damage steroid that amplifies every auto in the extended duel.
Double Strike: every few basic attacks strikes twice; in a sustained duel the proc fires repeatedly, ramping effective DPS the longer Yi stays in melee.
Alpha Strike: basic attacks on-hit reduce Alpha Strike's current cooldown by 1 second (affected by ability haste), continuously refreshing the ability window across a prolonged duel.
Highlander: grants large bonus attack speed and movement speed for 7 seconds; the AS component turns a long duel into a runaway attack-speed spiral against a single target.
Meditate: channels to restore a large amount of HP every 0.5 seconds, increased by up to 100% based on missing health - a powerful mid-duel heal that can turn losing fights.
Meditate also grants 70% damage reduction for the first 0.5 seconds then a reduced amount for the remaining channel, functioning as a defensive endurance layer during the heal window.
Stone Skin: stacks up to 5 by damaging enemy champions or monsters, each stack grants 5-9 bonus AD and 6-10 bonus armor; stacks in-combat
Stone Skin at 5 stacks: regenerates 2.1% maximum health every 5 seconds while in combat; requires fully stacked; sustains attrition phase
Crushing Blow: empowered strike reduces target armor by 20% for 3s; re-applicable on 6-8s CD in a prolonged duel, compounding his physical damage output
Cyclone: Wukong spins for up to 4s dealing continuous physical damage; during the spin he is largely unstoppable and sustains attacking output in a 1v1

Darkness Rise: after 3 ability/auto hits on enemies Mordekaiser activates a persistent AoE field dealing 5 (+ 30% AP) (+ 1-5% of target max health) magic damage per second and granting bonus movement speed - a sustained damage ramp aura active for the full duel duration once online

Realm of Death: banishes the target to a 1v1 death realm for 7 seconds, steals 10% of their core stats (AD, AP, AS, HP, armor, MR), heals Mordekaiser for 10% of their max HP, and removes all external interference - the defining extended-duel environment where his power ramp runs uncontested

Indestructible: passively stores 45% of damage dealt and 7.5% of damage taken as Potential Shield (up to 30% max health); on recast Mordekaiser consumes the remaining shield to heal himself - providing a periodic mid-duel HP refill on an 8-12s cooldown
Black Shield: absorbs magic damage and CC; in a 1v1 vs an AP or CC-heavy threat, grants a full spell-immunity window that can negate the opponent's key ability and swing the attrition fight
Soul Siphon: grants Morgana spellvamp; W (Tormented Shadow) ticking on a nearby enemy in a 1v1 continuously heals her, extending her ability to trade in melee range
Siphoning Strike permanently gains +3 damage per kill, compounding over the game so Nasus Q deals escalating true burst that grows unboundedly through the duel window.
Fury of the Sands drains nearby enemies for a percentage of their max HP each second, healing Nasus for the damage dealt, sustaining through the full ult duration.
Fury of the Sands grants Nasus bonus HP, increased size, and additional armor/MR shred on the target, amplifying his offensive and defensive identity for the duel duration.
Primal Surge (human form): heals Nidalee and grants bonus attack speed on self-cast, usable mid-duel when toggling back to human form
Aspect of the Cougar / Pounce: Pounce cooldown resets when Nidalee hits an enemy in cougar form, enabling rapid Pounce-Takedown chains
Formless Blade: Nilah's basic attacks and empowered Q strikes heal her for 0% : 20% (based on critical strike chance) of post-mitigation damage dealt to champions
Apotheosis: Nilah heals herself for 20% : 50% (based on critical strike chance) of post-mitigation damage dealt to champions during the whirl
Jubilant Veil: Nilah becomes ghosted, reduces all incoming magic damage by 25%, and dodges all non-turret basic attacks for the 2.25s active duration
Umbra Blades: every 10 attacks Nocturne's next attack cleaves nearby enemies and heals him for 13-30 HP per enemy hit; fires continuously in a prolonged fight
Duskbringer: leaves an 8s trail granting Nocturne +15-35 bonus AD while standing on it; in a 1v1 he stays on the trail sustaining the AD bonus continuously
Shroud of Darkness: Nocturne creates a shield for 1.5s; if it blocks a spell it doubles in power and grants bonus attack speed for 5s; spell shield negates one key ability

Consume: Willump bites the target enemy champion, healing himself (heal increased by 50% when below 50% max health) - a periodic mid-duel HP refill on an 8-12s cooldown that keeps Nunu fighting through sustained exchanges
Reckless Swing: deals true damage on roughly 7-11s CD; bypasses all armor and shields to deliver reliable damage that cannot be mitigated by defensive itemisation in a long fight
Berserker Rage: Olaf gains bonus attack speed as his health decreases, making him progressively more dangerous the lower he gets in a sustained fight
Ragnarok: makes Olaf immune to all CC while gaining bonus AD and chasing freely; neutralises kite/peel and lets him stay on target through the entire duel
Tough It Out: grants omnivamp and a shield that scales with missing HP; the lower Olaf's HP the larger the shield, enabling a powerful mid-duel recovery

Living Forge: Ornn's abilities apply Brittle stacks to enemies; his next basic attack after any ability consumes Brittle to deal bonus percent maximum health physical damage, re-triggerable on each ability cast in the rotation and re-firing the empowered auto within a sustained duel.

Bellows Breath makes Ornn unstoppable and briefly grants bonus armor and magic resistance for the channel duration; this DR and CC-immunity window lets him absorb an opponent's burst without being locked down, conditional on W being available.
Aegis Assault makes Pantheon invulnerable to damage from the front for the duration, channeling a sustained block window that negates incoming damage mid-duel.
Mortal Will charges a stack on every ability cast; at 5 stacks the next ability is empowered, cycling an enhanced strike or shield repeatedly throughout a prolonged duel.
Iron Ambassador: buckler shield proc on cooldown grants Poppy a shield equal to 11-20% of her maximum health for 3 seconds, providing a repeated defensive layer across an extended 1v1.

Steadfast Presence passive: Poppy increases her total armor and total magic resistance by 12%, doubled to 24% while below 40% max health - a sustained resist buff that scales her durability as the duel runs long.
Gift of the Drowned Ones: while briefly out of enemy vision Pyke rapidly regenerates HP, giving him a conditional mid-duel recovery window when he can disengage momentarily.
Death from Below: executes an enemy below the threshold and fully resets the cooldown, allowing Pyke to re-enter the duel or chase a surviving target with his full kit available.

Defensive Ball Curl: Rammus gains massive bonus armor and magic resistance and deals thorns damage (15 + 10% armor + 10% MR) to every attacker on-hit - the longer an AD champion auto-attacks him in this state the more damage they reflect back
Furious Bite: at full fury deals true damage instead of physical damage, providing a full-fury true-damage spike that can fire periodically after refuelling mid-duel
Fury of the Xer'Sai: burrowing while fury is available heals Rek'Sai, enabling brief mid-duel regeneration windows to extend attrition fights

Break the Mold: each auto-attack against an enemy champion steals a portion of their armor and magic resistance permanently for the rest of the game, building a growing resistance differential the more Rell attacks in the duel
Slice and Dice grants two consecutive dashes, letting Renekton re-enter or re-position mid-duel and effectively reset his melee range for the next combo cycle.
Reign of Anger passively generates Fury from attacks; at 50+ Fury his next ability gains an empowered effect, feeding a continuous enhanced-ability loop throughout the duel.
Cull the Meek heals Renekton for each enemy hit; the Fury-empowered version heals for triple the amount, providing substantial mid-duel HP restoration on each cast.
Ferocity stacks build passively during combat up to 4; reaching 4 empowers the next ability, meaning the longer the duel runs the more empowered casts occur.

Savagery: basic attacks gain 40% attack speed on the two empowered strikes; the empowered Ferocity version fires with massive bonus damage and 50-101% AS for 5 seconds, effectively re-firing the damage combo rapidly within the ferocity generation cycle.
Battle Roar: consumes stored grey health (50% of recent damage taken) to heal Rengar; empowered version heals for significantly more, providing attrition-winning sustain in extended melee.
Battle Roar empowered also cleanses all crowd control; the base cast stores recent damage as grey health providing a defensive cycle that extends his duel longevity.
Riven is a resourceless champion with no mana cost on any ability, allowing her to cycle her full combo repeatedly throughout the duel without resource exhaustion.
Valor: Riven dashes and gains a shield equal to 10-20% of her bonus AD plus base amount - on-demand defensive layer woven repeatedly into the fight.
Broken Wings: three dashes that deal increasing damage, each charge resets and can be woven with auto-attacks - the core combo loop that re-fires within a single duel.
Blade of the Exile: significantly empowers Riven's AD scaling for its duration, amplifying every subsequent hit and dash within the duel window.
Heat-based resourceless kit: abilities build and spend heat rather than mana, letting Rumble fight indefinitely without running dry
Junkyard Titan: at 50-99 heat (Danger Zone) all abilities are empowered; at 100 heat (Overheat) Rumble gains attack speed and on-hit magic damage
Scrap Shield: grants Rumble a shield and bonus movement speed on activation, cyclable approximately every 6 seconds throughout a sustained fight
Arcane Mastery combo loop: E applies Flux debuff, Q and W consume it for empowered effects, then E re-applies Flux on a short rotation, creating a continuous combo re-fire cycle within a single duel
Daredevil Impulse: Samira builds Style grade (D through S) by using different attacks in quick succession, each rank up granting bonus movement speed and empowering her damage cadence
Inferno Trigger: available only at S-style grade; fires rapidly at all nearby enemies 10 times for 0.25s each; completing the style ramp re-fires her entire damage kit in a single window
Blade Whirl: Samira slashes around her twice over 1s destroying all non-turret missiles that enter the area; negates a full wave of projectile burst mid-duel

Frost Armor: when taking damage from enemy champions, Sejuani gains slow immunity, cripple immunity, 10 (+ 75% bonus armor) bonus armor, and 10 (+ 75% bonus MR) for 3 seconds refreshing on subsequent hits - a near-permanent defensive layer that keeps her fighting under sustained enemy pressure
Absolution: collecting Mist Wraiths permanently increases Senna's AD, crit, and range; a long-game RAMP that enters any 1v1 with accumulated power but does not compound within the duel itself
Piercing Darkness: fires a beam that damages enemies and heals Senna and allies it passes through; on roughly 8-10s CD in a 1v1 this provides reliable periodic self-sustain to extend the fight

Dawning Shadow: the global heal/shield component restores a significant chunk of HP and shields Senna mid-duel; used when available it provides a one-time recovery burst that can swing a close attrition fight

Pit Grit: Sett regenerates health every 0.5 seconds, scaling sharply with missing health toward a maximum per-tick heal; provides sustained mid-duel attrition recovery that becomes most powerful when Sett is low, conditional on being below his health threshold.

Knuckle Down fires two empowered punches on a short cooldown (~12s), granting Sett bonus movement speed toward his target and bonus damage on each punch; re-usable multiple times in a prolonged duel, each cycle re-firing the damage spike.

Haymaker converts up to 50% of damage Sett absorbed as Grit into a shield equal to that stored Grit before expelling it; effectively converts raw punishment taken during a sustained exchange into a defensive buffer that reduces net damage, without a gate beyond having taken damage.

Hallucinate creates a controllable clone of Shaco; the doppelganger effectively doubles his presence in the duel, providing a second body that absorbs hits and explodes on death, extending his survival window.
Ki Barrier: after completing an ability's effects, Shen grants himself a shield; in a sustained duel Shen cycles abilities to repeatedly refresh the shield, absorbing meaningful damage.

Twilight Assault: recalls Spirit Blade and empowers the next 3 basic attacks with bonus magic damage and (if blade hit a champion) 50% bonus attack speed - a recurring empowered AA window on roughly a 9-second cooldown that re-fires the damage combo across the duel.
Spirit's Refuge: creates a zone that causes Shen to dodge all non-turret basic attacks for 1.75 seconds; negating a burst of auto-attacks extends Shen's 1v1 longevity.
Shyvana generates Fury with basic attacks and abilities; Fury fills faster in extended combat and gates her dragon-form power, making longer fights inherently more favorable for her.
Dragon's Blood: Shyvana's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and she gains bonus armor and magic resistance, both permanently scaling with her Fury and dragon slayer stacks.

Dragon's Descent: Shyvana transforms into a dragon, gaining large bonus HP, empowered E, and enhanced stat profile; Fury depletes during dragon form, making uptime conditional on how long she fought to fill it.
Poison Trail: toggle ability with no mana cost; Singed runs indefinitely dealing continuous poison damage without resource depletion
Insanity Potion: grants a large steroid of AP, armor, MR, attack speed, movement speed, lifesteal, and regen for 25s
Insanity Potion: grants lifesteal and omnivamp in addition to combat stats, healing Singed off his continuous poison trail damage during the duel
Glory in Death: upon taking lethal damage Sion reanimates with 100% life steal and rapidly decaying health, allowing him to continue fighting and potentially kill the opponent even after being downed
Soul Furnace: Sion gains a large shield scaling with bonus health (up to 1000 max) that he can detonate for massive damage, absorbing huge chunks of incoming burst during a duel
Spell Shield: absorbs one enemy ability and refunds 150 mana; in a 1v1 negates the opponent's single most impactful ability and extends Sivir's resource window

Threads of Vibration: Skarner's autos and abilities apply Quaking stacks (max 3); enemies at 3 stacks take magic damage equal to 5-9% of their max health over the duration - a sustained ramp that grows with the target's HP pool and maintains itself through his melee combo loop

Shattered Earth / Upheaval: empowers three consecutive basic attacks with bonus damage, then Upheaval re-fires as a ranged boulder throw - the Q->empowered-autos->Upheaval cycle on a 7-13s cooldown re-fires his full auto-attack combo within a sustained melee duel

Seismic Bastion: Skarner shields himself for 8% of his maximum health for 2.5 seconds on a 6-10s cooldown - a periodic refreshing defensive layer that lets him absorb burst windows while trading in a sustained 1v1
Dragon Practice: stacks from abilities and kills permanently upgrade Super Scorcher Breath at 25/125/225 stacks, increasing Q's damage ceiling the more stacks Smolder has accumulated
Mommomm's Oven: Smolder calls in a large AOE that heals allies (including Smolder) within the zone; provides a one-time mid-duel HP recovery window when available

Starcall: if the stardust returns to Soraka after hitting an enemy champion, she gains Rejuvenation for 2.5 seconds, healing her every 0.5 seconds; provides a repeating self-heal in a 1v1 only if she can consistently land Q and stand in the return zone, conditional on hitting an enemy champion.
Ravenous Flock passively accumulates Soul Fragments from enemy champions hit, granting permanent max HP per soul, scaling his dueling bulk the longer he fights.
Demonic Ascension drains nearby enemies for magic damage each second while healing Swain for the full amount drained, making him nearly unkillable in a prolonged close-range duel.
Demonic Ascension grants Swain bonus health and transforms him, increasing his stat profile and drain damage output for the full ult duration.
Abscond/Abduct (E1/E2): dash plus gap-close sequence with separate charges allows Sylas to stay on target and reset positioning within the duel repeatedly.
Petricite Burst: after casting a spell Sylas's next basic attack whirls chains around him for bonus damage; cycling spells continuously resets the empowered auto window, re-firing the combo.
Kingslayer: heals Sylas for a substantial amount scaling by 0-100% based on missing HP; the heal is largest when Sylas is low, making him extremely difficult to finish in a long duel.
Thick Skin: passive converts a portion of damage received into grey health, acting as a sustained damage buffer; active spends grey health for an additional shield

Bravado: after casting any ability, Taric's next two basic attacks gain 100% bonus attack speed and each reduce the remaining cooldowns of his basic abilities by 1-2 seconds - continuously cycling his ability loop throughout a sustained 1v1 exchange

Starlight's Touch: heals Taric (and nearby allies) for 25 (+ 15% AP) (+ 1% max health) per charge, up to 5 charges stocked via Bravado empowered attacks - a periodic in-combat self-heal that refills his HP as the duel progresses
Toxic Shot: every auto applies a stacking poison DoT that deals magic damage over 4s and refreshes; sustained poison pressure mounts the longer the duel continues
Blinding Dart: blinds the target causing their auto attacks to miss; on roughly 8s CD in a 1v1 this periodically nullifies the opponent's physical damage output, greatly extending Teemo's survival

Explosive Charge stacks up to 4 times via basic attacks and spells, then detonates for escalating bonus physical damage; re-applicable each cycle on a short cooldown, turning sustained auto-attacks into a repeating damage ramp that re-fires every ~12s throughout a long duel.

Rapid Fire grants Tristana substantially increased attack speed for 7 seconds; during this window her auto-attack cadence rises sharply, compounding with Explosive Charge stacks and on-hit effects to elevate sustained output over the duel window.
Chomp bites the target, dealing bonus damage and reducing their AD by a percentage for 4 seconds, stacking offense and anti-offense continuously through repeated casts.
Subjugate steals a percentage of the target's Armor, MR, and HP, continuously transferring stats to Trundle over 4 seconds - the target weakens as Trundle strengthens.
Subjugate heals Trundle for the HP stolen from the target over the drain duration, providing substantial mid-duel recovery while simultaneously weakening the enemy.
Frozen Domain grants Trundle a large Movement Speed and Attack Speed bonus in the icy zone, giving him a sustained attrition advantage for the zone duration.
Frozen Domain also increases Trundle's healing and shielding by a percentage, amplifying any lifesteal and in-fight sustain received during the zone.

Spinning Slash: critical strikes on-hit reduce Spinning Slash's current cooldown by 0.75 seconds (1.5 seconds against champions), continuously refreshing his gap-close mobility within a crit-spiraling duel.

Battle Fury: basic attacks generate Fury (crits and kills generate more); higher Fury raises crit chance up to 50%, and crits also generate more Fury, creating an escalating crit spiral the longer the duel runs.
Bloodlust passive: Tryndamere gains bonus attack damage that increases further based on his missing health - the lower he gets, the harder he hits, ramping damage output as the duel extends.
Bloodlust active: consumes all Fury to heal Tryndamere, with the heal scaling with missing health and Fury consumed, allowing a mid-duel reset of HP - a genuine attrition tool.

Undying Rage: Tryndamere cannot be reduced below 1 HP for 5 seconds and instantly gains full Fury on cast; the ultimate extended-duel endurance tool - an invulnerable attack window no burst kit can skip.
Undying Rage fills Tryndamere to full Fury on cast, giving immediate 50% crit chance and maximizing Bloodlust heal - compounding both RAMP and DUELHEAL while active.
Deadly Venom: basic attacks stack poison on the target up to 6 times, increasing Contaminate damage per stack throughout the sustained fight
Ambush: exiting stealth grants stacking bonus attack speed (up to 50% for 5s), ramping Twitch's attack output at the start of the duel

Stance cycling: Udyr continuously rotates between Wilding Claw, Iron Mantle, Blazing Stampede, and Wingborne Storm with overlapping short cooldowns, re-firing each stance's empowered proc in a non-stop loop
Wilding Claw: Udyr gains persistent attack speed stacks while in the Wilding Claw stance, ramping his DPS output the longer he stays in the fight attacking
Iron Mantle Awaken: empowered attacks gain doubled life steal up to 40% at rank 6, providing sustained healing from every auto attack during prolonged exchanges
Iron Mantle: passively grants a periodic shield that refreshes as Udyr cycles stances, giving him recurring defensive absorption throughout the duel
Echoing Flames: each leg periodically fires automatically when enemies are nearby dealing physical plus 6% max HP damage; passive leg procs re-fire damage ticks throughout the duel
Purge: Urgot shields himself and rapidly fires his legs for 4s dealing 60-100 (+0.36 total AD) plus 6% current HP physical damage; sustained % HP dps output that compounds over time
Purge: simultaneously grants Urgot a 60-100 HP shield while the mode is active, layering defense onto his sustained offensive pressure

Blighted Quiver passive: basic attacks apply Blight stacks (max 3) on-hit; each stack detonated by abilities deals bonus magic damage per stack equal to 2.5-4% of the target's max health - a per-auto ramp sustained across the exchange as long as Varus can land autos and detonate with abilities
Tumble: short CD repositioning dash that empowers the next auto attack; refreshes continuously within a duel to stack Silver Bolts and reposition for safety
Final Hour: grants bonus AD, empowers Tumble with invisibility and resets its CD, extending and accelerating the Q-Silver Bolts cycle throughout the duel
Silver Bolts: every third consecutive auto deals bonus true damage equal to a percentage of target's max HP, scaling infinitely with tank itemisation and rewarding extended auto-trading
Blast Shield: periodically, Vi's next ability hit grants her a shield equal to 12% of her maximum health for 3 seconds; the repeated on-hit shield provides sustained defensive layers in a 1v1.
Denting Blows: stacks on the same target up to 3 times; at 3 stacks deals bonus % current HP physical damage and grants bonus attack speed - a continuous damage ramp the longer Vi attacks one target.
Sovereign's Domination: upon killing an enemy champion, Viego briefly possesses their corpse and restores a portion of his health, effectively resetting the duel from a fresh state.
Blade of the Ruined King empowered form: healing himself for 135% of the post-mitigation damage dealt while the wraith blade buff is active.
Siphon Power: grants Viktor a shield of 40-115 (based on level) (+ 18% AP) on cast with an approximately 8s cooldown, providing recurring defensive layers in a duel
Tides of Blood: each cast adds a stack (up to 4) that increases Vladimir's healing from Transfusion and damage output, so the longer the duel runs the more dangerous and self-sustaining he becomes
Transfusion: Vladimir heals himself on each Q cast; Crimson Rush empowered version heals for substantially more, providing constant mid-fight health regeneration on roughly a 9s effective cadence
Sanguine Pool: Vladimir becomes untargetable and drains enemies for 4s, healing for 30% of pre-mitigation damage dealt while enemies' attacks pass through him - a decisive mid-duel survival tool
Sanguine Pool: Vladimir heals himself for 30% of pre-mitigation damage dealt to enemies within the pool over the 4s duration while untargetable
The Relentless Storm: after 3 attacks on the same target Volibear's attacks deal 75-250 (+0.6 AP) bonus magic damage and generate lightning; sustained within a prolonged single fight
Stormbringer: Volibear leaps and gains 100-175 bonus HP for 12s on landing; the temporary HP and empowered storm sustain his presence through a prolonged duel window
Frenzied Maul: Volibear mauls the target applying a bleed and healing himself for 150-360 (+0.4 bonus AD) HP on the bite; short cooldown makes this the core sustain engine in a long duel

Primal Howl: Warwick gains damage reduction for up to 2.5 seconds on an 11-15s cooldown - a periodic defensive window that lets him absorb burst while his healing keeps him alive through extended duel exchanges

Eternal Hunger: Warwick deals bonus magic damage on-hit and heals for 100% of that post-mitigation damage; below 50% HP the healing triples - a defining mid-duel sustain that snowballs as Warwick gets low and the fight extends

Jaws of the Beast: Warwick lunges and bites for percentage of target's max HP magic damage, healing himself for a percentage of all post-mitigation damage dealt by the bite - a major periodic HP injection on a 6-8s cooldown

Infinite Duress: Warwick leaps and suppresses the target for 1.5 seconds, healing for 100% of all post-mitigation damage dealt during the suppression while applying on-hits 3 times - simultaneously preventing counterplay and refilling his HP bar

Blood Hunt passive: Warwick gains bonus attack speed (doubled below 25% HP) for 1.25 seconds upon damaging a target below 50% HP, refreshing on subsequent hits - the lower the enemy falls the faster Warwick attacks, compounding his Eternal Hunger healing and on-hit damage simultaneously

Featherstorm: Xayah becomes briefly untargetable while raining feathers; used in a 1v1 to dodge a key incoming ability or burst window, then re-engaging with feathers already on the ground for an E recall
Deadly Plumage: grants attack speed and healing on every auto hit for the duration; a concentrated burst steroid that amplifies both damage and sustain during the engagement window
Deadly Plumage: heals Xayah for each auto landing during the steroid window, providing mid-duel HP recovery proportional to attack speed

Audacious Charge dashes to a target and grants Xin Zhao bonus attack speed for 3 seconds upon landing; immediately accelerates his auto-attack output at the start of or during the duel, synergizing with his passive's every-third-auto heal and Three Talon Strike combo cycling.

Determination: every third basic attack deals bonus physical damage and heals Xin Zhao for a percentage of his maximum health plus AP; fires continuously throughout a duel with no cooldown or resource gate, providing reliable in-fight sustain that scales with his HP pool.

Three Talon Strike empowers Xin Zhao's next 3 attacks to deal bonus damage, each hit reducing his other ability cooldowns by 1 second, with the third hit knocking up; the cooldown refund chainable across the duel lets him re-fire Q and other combo abilities more rapidly throughout a prolonged exchange.
Sweeping Blade has no cooldown between different targets and resets Yasuo's position to an adjacent unit repeatedly, enabling continuous repositioning and re-entry into melee range through the duel.

Way of the Wanderer makes Yasuo resourceless (no mana), allowing unlimited ability casts throughout the duel with no attrition cost; Flow shield charges off movement provide periodic defensive layers.
Last Breath can only be cast on airborne targets and resets Yasuo's combo by repositioning him to the target mid-air, re-opening his full Q-E rotation after the knockup.
Wind Wall blocks all projectiles for 4 seconds, providing a one-sided defensive barrier that negates a class of ranged damage during the duel window.

Soul Unbound: Yone's body is untargetable for up to 5 seconds while in Spirit Form; on recast, marks on champions deal true damage equal to stored post-mitigation damage - an endurance window that sidesteps lethal damage.

Way of the Hunter - Steel and Spirit: Yone's basic attacks alternate swords; every other attack with the Azakana Sword deals 50% AD physical and 50% AD magic damage, a continuous dual-damage output that ramps effective DPS the longer Yone attacks.

Mortal Steel: third consecutive hit consumes 2 Gathering Storm stacks to launch a whirlwind that knocks up; the 3-hit cycle resets continuously through the duel, re-firing the knockup combo every few casts.

Spirit Cleave: if it hits an enemy, Yone grants himself a shield (doubled if it hits a champion) for 1.5 seconds - a repeatedly refreshable defensive layer on roughly a 9-second cooldown across the duel.

Mourning Mist: marks an enemy, causing all nearby Mist Walkers and the Maiden to rush the target - converts Yorick's ghoul army into sustained focused pressure, keeping him protected while ghouls do work.
Shepherd of Souls: Yorick raises up to 4 Mist Walkers; more ghouls active means more surrounding auto-attack DPS that accumulates throughout a prolonged fight.
Last Rites: Yorick's empowered AA deals bonus damage and heals him for a portion of the damage dealt, providing consistent mid-duel HP recovery each time the ability comes off cooldown.
Eulogy of the Isles: summons the Maiden of the Mist who attacks alongside Yorick and spawns ghouls on kills, providing persistent supplementary DPS that compounds the longer the duel lasts.
Cell Division: when Zac takes damage chunks of himself fall off; he can pick them up to heal for 4-8% of his maximum health per blob; requires living blobs on the ground
Unstable Matter: on 5s CD Zac explodes his body dealing 4-6% of nearby enemies current HP as magic damage; fires continuously in a prolonged duel compounding % HP pressure
Spark Surge: Zeri's Q cooldown is reduced by autos and abilities landing; in a sustained fight the continuous Q CD reduction keeps burst fire cycling at a greatly accelerated rate
Lightning Crash: Overcharges Zeri with stacking move speed and attack speed charges; each auto landing in the Overcharged state refreshes a charge and empowers burst fire spray

Chronoshift: Zilean can self-cast this to place a revive buff that restores him to partial health if he dies within 5 seconds; functions as a second-life window in a 1v1 duel, conditional on ult availability, allowing him to survive what would otherwise be a killing blow and continue the exchange.
